edge_legend.zh_cn: 患者级数据或结构化结果

edge_legend.en: Outbound transfer across the local boundary

description.zh_cn: 当前开发流程固定召集5个核心临床专家，再由路由器从20个动态专科专家中最多选择6个；未选角色记为 not_applicable。软件实现不代表已经DR.ECC/MIMIC证明与顶尖专家临床等效。
description.en: The current development workflow always convenes five core clinical experts, then selects at most six from twenty dynamic specialists; unselected roles are recorded as not_applicable. Software implementation does not establish clinical equivalence to elite specialists without DR.ECC/MIMIC validation.

name.zh_cn: 开发/严格模式契约

description.zh_cn: 开发模式只强制技术完整性；适用范围、OOD 和校准仅记录为观察告警。
description.en: Development mode enforces technical integrity only; scope, OOD and calibration are observation warnings.

name.zh_cn: Provider、权重与密钥注册表

description.zh_cn: 加密保存密钥，冻结本次可用 Provider 清单，按权重分配 Agent。
description.en: Encrypts credentials, freezes ready providers and assigns Agents by weight.

name.zh_cn: 网络安全、隐私与审计

description.zh_cn: 保留 SSRF、重定向、响应大小、密钥脱敏和完整性哈希边界。
description.en: Keeps SSRF, redirect, response-size, secret-redaction and integrity-hash boundaries.

name.zh_cn: 纯虚构/已脱敏病例全文

description.zh_cn: 全文是开发 Agent 的主要推理依据；本地抽取只作索引和矛盾提示。
description.en: Full text is the primary reasoning source; local extraction is only an index and contradiction aid.

name.zh_cn: 快照、执行图与完整性预检

description.zh_cn: 调用模型前核对输入、Provider、治理配置及执行图哈希。
description.en: Checks input, provider, governance and execution-graph hashes before model egress.

name.zh_cn: 适用性与输入质量观察

description.zh_cn: 开发模式中只记录告警，不弃答、不降级为大类。
description.en: Records warnings without abstention or category downgrade in development mode.

name.zh_cn: 稳定来源分段编译器

description.zh_cn: 为全文句段生成 source_fragment_id，所有 Agent 用 ID 引用病例证据。
description.en: Assigns source_fragment_id values so every Agent can cite case evidence.

name.zh_cn: 临床专家会诊路由器

description.zh_cn: 固定召集5个核心专家，再从20个动态专科中最多选择6个，记录 selected/not_applicable。
description.en: Always convenes five core experts and selects at most six of twenty dynamic specialists, recording selected/not_applicable.

name.zh_cn: 感染科首席专家

description.zh_cn: 统合综合征、宿主、暴露、病原学与治疗干扰。
description.en: Integrates syndrome, host, exposure, microbiology and treatment interference.

name.zh_cn: 重症与急诊医学专家
name.en: Critical Care and Emergency Medicine Expert

description.zh_cn: 重建器官衰竭、干预、源控制与重症模拟病。
description.en: Reconstructs organ failure, interventions, source control and critical-care mimics.

name.zh_cn: 临床流行病学专家

description.zh_cn: 审核暴露时序、地区季节先验与流行信号。
description.en: Audits exposure timing, regional-seasonal priors and epidemiologic signals.

name.zh_cn: 检验医学专家

description.zh_cn: 审核检验时序、质量、冲突与病理生理模式。
description.en: Audits laboratory timing, quality, conflicts and pathophysiologic patterns.

name.zh_cn: 临床微生物与培养实验室专家
name.en: Clinical Microbiology and Culture Laboratory Expert

description.zh_cn: 审核标本、染色、培养、药敏、污染/定植与用药干扰。
description.en: Audits specimens, stains, culture, susceptibility, contamination/colonization and treatment effects.

name.zh_cn: 放射影像专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 影像定位、形态、播散与模拟病。
description.en: Imaging localization, morphology, dissemination and mimics.

name.zh_cn: 呼吸与危重呼吸专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 肺部感染定位、呼吸道标本与肺部模拟病。
description.en: Pulmonary localization, respiratory specimens and pulmonary mimics.

name.zh_cn: 消化内科专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 胃肠道感染、腹膜炎与肠源菌血症。
description.en: Gastrointestinal infection, peritonitis and enteric-source bacteremia.

name.zh_cn: 肝胆胰专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 肝脏灶、胆道感染、胰腺病变与引流。
description.en: Hepatic lesions, biliary infection, pancreatic disease and drainage.

name.zh_cn: 泌尿外科与复杂尿路感染专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 梗阻、器械、复杂尿路感染与引流。
description.en: Obstruction, devices, complicated UTI and drainage.

name.zh_cn: 肾脏内科专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: AKI、肾炎、TMA、药物损伤与横纹肌溶解。
description.en: AKI, nephritis, TMA, drug injury and rhabdomyolysis.

name.zh_cn: 神经内科与神经感染专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 神经定位、脑脊液解读与神经模拟病。
description.en: Neurologic localization, CSF interpretation and neurologic mimics.

name.zh_cn: 心血管与心内膜炎专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 心内膜炎、心肌/心包炎、栓塞与心肌损伤。
description.en: Endocarditis, myocarditis/pericarditis, embolism and myocardial injury.

name.zh_cn: 血液与临床免疫专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 细胞减少、溶血、凝血、免疫缺陷与炎症过度激活。
description.en: Cytopenia, hemolysis, coagulation, immune deficiency and hyperinflammation.

name.zh_cn: 移植感染专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 移植阶段、免疫抑制、预防突破与再激活。
description.en: Transplant phase, immunosuppression, prophylaxis breakthrough and reactivation.

name.zh_cn: 外科与源控制专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 需手术/介入的腹腔、软组织、坏死与脓肿灶。
description.en: Abdominal, soft-tissue, necrotic and abscess sources needing intervention.

name.zh_cn: 骨科与骨关节感染专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 骨髓炎、化脓性关节炎、脊柱与植入物感染。
description.en: Osteomyelitis, septic arthritis, spinal and implant infection.

name.zh_cn: 皮肤科与软组织感染专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 皮损形态、入口、坏死性感染与模拟病。
description.en: Lesion morphology, portals, necrotizing infection and mimics.

name.zh_cn: 妇产科感染专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 孕期、产后、宫腔/盆腔感染与母胎风险。
description.en: Pregnancy, postpartum, uterine/pelvic infection and maternal-fetal risk.

name.zh_cn: 儿科、新生儿与儿童感染专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 年龄特异生理、围产暴露、免疫发育与疫苗。
description.en: Age-specific physiology, perinatal exposure, immune development and vaccination.

name.zh_cn: 热带病与寄生虫专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 地理、旅行、媒介、食物/水体与寄生虫检测。
description.en: Geography, travel, vectors, food/water and parasite testing.

name.zh_cn: 医学真菌专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 侵袭性真菌病、定植/污染与真菌学检测。
description.en: Invasive mycoses, colonization/contamination and fungal diagnostics.

name.zh_cn: 临床病毒学与分子诊断专家（动态）
name.en: Clinical Virology and Molecular Diagnostics Expert (Dynamic)

description.zh_cn: 病毒检测窗口、活动感染、再激活与偶然检出。
description.en: Viral test windows, active infection, reactivation and incidental detection.

name.zh_cn: 抗菌药物管理与临床药学专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 药物覆盖、穿透、剂量、检出率干扰与耐药压力。
description.en: Drug coverage, penetration, dose, test-yield interference and resistance pressure.

name.zh_cn: 医疗相关与器械感染专家（动态）

description.zh_cn: 导管、假体、生物膜、污染/定植与耐药风险。
description.en: Catheters, prostheses, biofilm, contamination/colonization and resistance risk.

name.zh_cn: 证据委员会与候选板

description.zh_cn: 汇合并跨证据域去重核心与动态 Agent 的意见；当前确定性核对片段 ID 是否存在，但尚不能证明 Agent 陈述与所引片段在语义上完全一致。
description.en: Combines and deduplicates core and dynamic Agent opinions across evidence domains. It currently verifies source-fragment membership, but does not yet prove semantic entailment between every Agent statement and its cited fragment.

name.zh_cn: 医学证据检索规划器

description.zh_cn: 将证据板转换为去标识化的综合征、暴露、候选病原、类似病例与公共卫生查询，不发送病例全文。
description.en: Turns the evidence board into de-identified syndrome, exposure, pathogen, similar-case and public-health queries without sending full case text.

name.zh_cn: 文献与类似病例检索

description.zh_cn: 从 Europe PMC 与 PubMed/NCBI 检索文献、类似病例和病原分类信息。
description.en: Retrieves literature, similar cases and taxonomy information from Europe PMC and PubMed/NCBI.

name.zh_cn: 公共卫生、指南与疫情信号检索
name.en: Public-health, Guideline and Outbreak Signal Retrieval

description.zh_cn: 已实时查询 WHO 疫情通报；CDC、ECDC、中国疾控及专业学会当前只进入版本化来源目录，尚未实时检索。无命中不会被解释为无疫情或无相关指南。
description.en: Live-searches WHO outbreak notices. CDC, ECDC, China CDC and professional societies are currently versioned catalog entries rather than live-search connectors. No hit is never interpreted as absence.

name.zh_cn: 外部证据核验与重排

description.zh_cn: 当前确定性核对来源、引用及题名与检索概念的重叠，并排除仅凭搜索排序的记录；摘要/全文蕴含核验仍在规划中。
description.en: Currently checks provenance, citation identity and deterministic title-concept overlap, excluding search-rank-only records; abstract/full-text entailment verification remains planned.

name.zh_cn: 病原体总诊 Agent

description.zh_cn: 综合原文、全部已运行 Agent 意见、证据板与外部核验证据，生成恰好5个具体病原体。
description.en: Combines source text, all executed Agent opinions, the evidence board and verified external evidence into exactly five concrete pathogens.

name.zh_cn: 术语、Taxonomy 与 Top-5 合同检查

description.zh_cn: 确定性拒绝大类、重复、错误排序、不存在的片段 ID 或未解析名称；片段与医学陈述的语义一致性仍需独立核验。
description.en: Deterministically rejects categories, duplicates, rank errors, unknown fragment IDs and unresolved names; semantic consistency between a fragment and a medical claim still requires independent verification.

name.zh_cn: 独立反证审稿 Agent

description.zh_cn: 从遗漏、替代解释、反对证据和证据错配角度挑战 Top-5；优先使用不同模型指纹。
description.en: Challenges the Top-5 for omissions, alternative explanations, counter-evidence and citation mismatch, preferably with a different model fingerprint.

name.zh_cn: 最多一次总诊修订

description.zh_cn: 只在合同或反证审稿明确发现问题时调用，不进行无限循环。
description.en: Runs only when contract validation or counter-evidence review identifies a specific problem; it never loops indefinitely.

name.zh_cn: Top-5 候选证据补强

description.zh_cn: 已按最终具体病原体逐一检索并用题名精确绑定可追溯文献，不改写排名；同义词与摘要级召回仍需扩展。
description.en: Searches each final pathogen and binds traceable literature by exact title evidence without changing rank; synonym and abstract-level recall remain to be expanded.

name.zh_cn: 双语 v3 结果编译器

description.zh_cn: 输出具体 Top-5、大类概览、Unknown、共感染、下一检查、证据和 Agent 摘要。
description.en: Builds concrete Top-5, categories, unknown, coinfection, next tests, evidence and Agent summaries.

name.zh_cn: 轨迹、结果与完整性哈希

description.zh_cn: 冻结执行图、每个 Agent 的结构化输出、版本和 SHA-256。
description.en: Freezes the execution graph, normalized Agent outputs, versions and SHA-256.

name.zh_cn: 离线评价、外部验证与发布门槛
name.en: Offline Evaluation, External Validation and Release Gates

description.zh_cn: 工程轨迹测试已实现；多中心临床验证、概率校准与静默运行仍未完成。
description.en: Engineering trace tests exist; multicentre validation, calibration and silent deployment remain incomplete.

description.zh_cn: 用于研发路线和比赛展示；规划节点不代表已经上线或经过临床验证。
description.en: Used for the research roadmap and competition presentation; planned nodes are not deployed or clinically validated.

name.zh_cn: 适用范围契约

description.zh_cn: 定义人群、场景、用途、排除条件和当前决策时点。
description.en: Defines population, setting, purpose, exclusions and current decision time.

name.zh_cn: 模型、校准器、知识库与工具注册中心
name.en: Model, Calibrator, Knowledge and Tool Registry

description.zh_cn: 只有验证并冻结版本的组件才能发布。
description.en: Only validated and frozen component versions may be released.

name.zh_cn: 身份权限、隐私、监控、熔断与回滚
name.en: Identity, Privacy, Monitoring, Circuit Breaking and Rollback

description.zh_cn: 目标为可追溯、最小权限、持续监测和可回滚发布。
description.en: Targets traceability, least privilege, continuous monitoring and reversible release.

name.zh_cn: 当前决策时点临床事件账本

description.zh_cn: 只纳入在当前时间真正可见的证据。
description.en: Includes only evidence genuinely visible at the current time.

name.zh_cn: 数据质量与适用性闸门

description.zh_cn: 检查单位、缺失、冲突、泄漏、隐私和分布外。
description.en: Checks units, missingness, conflict, leakage, privacy and distribution shift.

name.zh_cn: 临床证据编译器

description.zh_cn: 统一病史、暴露、生命体征、时间序列、影像报告与地区季节先验。
description.en: Unifies history, exposure, vitals, time series, imaging reports and regional-seasonal priors.

name.zh_cn: 感染/非感染与综合征路由

description.zh_cn: 先判断问题类型和感染部位，再进入病原推理。
description.en: Routes problem type and infection site before pathogen reasoning.

name.zh_cn: 判别式多模态模型

description.zh_cn: 目标支持经验证的结构化数据、影像报告及未来原始影像；当前未接入原始 CT。
description.en: Targets validated structured data, imaging reports and future raw imaging; raw CT is not currently connected.

name.zh_cn: 患者级生成式世界模型

description.zh_cn: 比较不同病原假设下当前证据和可能检查结果的相容性。
description.en: Compares compatibility of current evidence and possible test results under competing pathogen hypotheses.

name.zh_cn: 层级贝叶斯动态先验

description.zh_cn: 使用经治理的地区、医院、季节和疫情聚合先验。
description.en: Uses governed aggregate priors for region, hospital, season and outbreaks.

name.zh_cn: 层级、多标签与开放集融合

description.zh_cn: 统一类别、属、种、共感染、Unknown 和模型分歧。
description.en: Combines category, genus, species, coinfection, unknown causes and model disagreement.

name.zh_cn: 独立安全裁决、Conformal 与 OOD
name.en: Independent Safety Adjudication, Conformal and OOD

description.zh_cn: 校准、覆盖率、冲突、亚组与证据核验独立于预测模型。
description.en: Keeps calibration, coverage, conflict, subgroup and evidence checks independent of prediction models.

name.zh_cn: 五态决策

description.zh_cn: 感染不支持、物种集合、仅大类、需要更多信息或弃答。
description.en: Infection unlikely, species set, category only, more information needed or abstain.

name.zh_cn: 完整性哈希结构化结果

description.zh_cn: 冻结模型、数据、证据、版本和运行轨迹。
description.en: Freezes model, data, evidence, versions and execution trace.

name.zh_cn: 安全裁决后的报告生成 Agent

description.zh_cn: 未来只能读取已裁决结构化结果，不能修改排序、数值或安全状态。
description.en: May only read adjudicated structured results and may not change ranking, numbers or safety state.

name.zh_cn: 双语医生可读呈现

description.zh_cn: 中文主行、英文副行，共享一套结构化数值。
description.en: Chinese primary and English secondary text share one structured set of numbers.

name.zh_cn: 外部医生复核与最终临床决策
name.en: External Clinician Review and Final Clinical Decision

description.zh_cn: 这是系统之外的人工责任边界，不属于软件执行节点；当前系统不实现临床复核、签署或最终决策流程。
description.en: This is a human responsibility boundary outside the system, not a software execution node; the current system does not implement clinical review, sign-off or final decision workflows.

name.zh_cn: 多中心数据治理与因果标签仲裁
name.en: Multicentre Data Governance and Causal Label Adjudication

description.zh_cn: 将预测输入包与最终病原标签包严格隔离。
description.en: Strictly separates prediction input packages from final pathogen label packages.

name.zh_cn: 特征、模型、校准与消融实验
name.en: Feature, Model, Calibration and Ablation Experiments

description.zh_cn: 比较组件贡献并冻结可复现实验。
description.en: Measures component contributions and freezes reproducible experiments.

name.zh_cn: 时间外与地区外验证

description.zh_cn: 验证跨时间、医院、地区和关键亚组的可迁移性。
description.en: Validates transportability across time, hospitals, regions and critical subgroups.

name.zh_cn: Agent 轨迹评测与安全红队
name.en: Agent-trajectory Evaluation and Safety Red Teaming

description.zh_cn: 评价轨迹正确性、延迟、失败恢复、证据一致性和越权风险。
description.en: Evaluates trajectory correctness, latency, failure recovery, evidence consistency and authority violations.

name.zh_cn: 前瞻性静默运行

description.zh_cn: 不影响临床决策地观察真实工作流表现。
description.en: Observes real workflow performance without influencing clinical decisions.

name.zh_cn: 多学科人工发布评审

description.zh_cn: 只有通过预注册门槛的冻结组件才进入注册中心。
description.en: Only frozen components passing preregistered gates enter the registry.

name.zh_cn: 持续漂移监测、熔断与回滚
name.en: Continuous Drift Monitoring, Circuit Breaking and Rollback

description.zh_cn: 上线后持续监测并在风险升高时降级或回滚。
description.en: Continuously monitors deployment and degrades or rolls back when risk increases.
